20.description: Council approved reduced funding for two Saskatoon Open Door Society events, prioritizing event viability and alternative revenue sources.

chips.text: Saskatoon Open Door Society received less than the requested $2,000 for two events.
Funding decisions will prioritize event viability, alternative revenue

21.description: Saskatoon approved reduced funding for World Refugee Day and the Saskatoon Refugee Coalition, ensuring funds remain for other event sponsorships throughout the year.

chips.text: Saskatoon Refugee Coalition received reduced funding for their World Refugee Day event.

23.description: Saskatoon City Council approved an item concerning the Saskatoon Open Door Society's 45th Anniversary World Fusion Bazaar.
